Use post-story free roam to complete the remaining challenges and collections.
Check the ledger against all 54 other trophies before wrapping up.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.time: Roughly 100 hours of checklist cleanup
trophies.guide: Reach the game's 100% completion total, the largest cleanup task and the published hardest trophy. Use the in-game checklist at Progress > Stats to identify missing categories; trophy thresholds can be lower than 100% targets, so track both separately.
steps: Finish the campaign so the remaining activities are available in free roam.
Open Progress > Stats and review the 100% checklist category by category.
Complete every listed requirement until the total reaches 100%.
Recheck the list after each major activity block.
trophies.tip: Treat the in-game checklist as the authority for completion credit instead of guessing from a trophy counter.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.time: Several hours of stunt attempts
trophies.guide: Complete any mix of 250 stunts from jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, and base jumps. Both guides distinguish this threshold from the higher 300-stunt 100% target; under-bridge flights are described as a quick option, and the game tracks progress by region.
steps: Open Progress > Activities > Stunts to inspect category progress.
Choose easy entries from any of the four stunt categories.
Complete each stunt once; optional score challenges are not needed.
Continue until the trophy counter reaches 250.
trophies.tip: Record the counter after each session; the 100% target is higher than this trophy requirement.

source.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.time: About 1–3 hours while exploring
trophies.guide: Try the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade game, a race win, and a stunt. The sources agree that simple participation is enough for most classes, with a basket for basketball and a victory for the race category; check Progress > Activities for what remains.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see the category checklist.
Try fishing, hunting, golf, shooting, pool, basketball, an arcade game, and a stunt.
Sink one basket and win any race to complete those two categories.
Recheck the list for any missing activity type.
trophies.tip: Try new activities naturally during story downtime to avoid a dedicated cleanup sweep.

source.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

Complete each of its 42 challenges.
Replay any event below gold and adjust aim or timing.
Verify that the challenge board shows gold for every entry.
trophies.tip: Tune sensitivity and aim settings before starting the full medal run.

Complete the drone course and finish first.
Repeat at the remaining locations.

Build the Wanted Level to four stars while staying together.
Break line of sight and evade until the Wanted Level clears.

Take the aircraft, back it away from the gate, and get airborne.
Fly about one kilometre from the airport before returning to safety.

Reach the southern part of the base and get into a Rhino tank.
Use the tank to defeat enemies while remaining inside.
Wait for the trophy notification before leaving.
